verdict.rationale: No first-party docs describe signing in with an existing subscription plan. Community reports only imply it: a Google account is tied to Antigravity use (account bans over third-party usage), and a free individual plan exists. One user warns that an active Google AI Pro subscription does not guarantee access without a separate 'Antigravity entitlement', which is a significant caveat. Missing for 10: official documentation of subscription-based sign-in, clear mapping of which plans grant agent access, and hands-on confirmation that sign-in works reliably.
